d:
Machhliyon ko lagta tha
Ki jaise ve tarapti hain pani ke lie,
Pani bhi unke lie vaise hi tarapta hoga.
Lekin jab khincha jata hai jal,
To pani machhliyon ko chhorkar jal ke chhedon se nikal bhagta hai.
Pani machhliyon ka desh hai,
Lekin machhliyan apne desh ke bare men kuchh nahin jantin.
Aaj sahity tak ke Poetry On Loop men sunie naresh saksena ki kavitaen 'machhliyon ko lagta tha’, 'ek vriksh bhi bacha rahe', 'pani kya kar raha hai' aur 'sabhi chijen laut aati hain'.
